say:1:1520906001:1.text: Hoof, this is a gift from the Hunting God.
say:1:1520906001:1.source_cn: 蹄，这是狩猎神大人给你的恩赐。
say:1:1520906001:1.male: Hoof, this is a gift from the Hunting God.
say:1:1520906001:1.female: Hoof, this is a gift from the Hunting Goddess.

say:2:1520906002:1.text: He wants you to continue fighting for him, for the Wildborn.
say:2:1520906002:1.male: He wants you to continue fighting for him, for the Wildborn.
say:2:1520906002:1.female: She wants you to continue fighting for her, for the Wildborn.

say:5:1520906004:0.text: The Hunting God can heal your current wounds, but you might still get hurt in the future.
say:5:1520906004:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人能治愈现在的伤口，但你以后依然会受伤。
say:5:1520906004:0.male: The Hunting God can heal your current wounds, but you might still get hurt in the future.
say:5:1520906004:0.female: The Hunting God can heal your current wounds, but you might still get hurt in the future.

say:6:1520906005:0.text: If you get injured again, he wants you to keep living.
say:6:1520906005:0.male: If you get injured again, he wants you to keep living.
say:6:1520906005:0.female: If you get injured again, she wants you to keep living.

say:7:1520906006:0.text: But I only know how to fight and hunt... Without those, I can't do anything...
say:7:1520906006:0.source_cn: 可俺只会战斗打猎……没了这些，俺啥也做不了……

choice_prompt:8:1520906006.text: But I only know how to fight and hunt... Without those, I can't do anything...
choice_prompt:8:1520906006.source_cn: 可俺只会战斗打猎……没了这些，俺啥也做不了……

say:11:1520906007:1.text: Ah—right! Hoof, you've seen the Halian traps. Show others how to avoid them.
say:11:1520906007:1.source_cn: 噢……对！蹄，你见识过呼临人的陷阱，可以教其他人怎么分辨。

say:12:1520906008:1.text: If the traps have value, tell Kordan. The Wildborn could craft their own!
say:12:1520906008:1.source_cn: 要是那陷阱好用的话，你告诉戈丹，雅库伯尔肯定也能造一批出来！

say:13:1520906009:1.text: Yeah... why didn't I think of that!

say:14:1520906010:1.text: Now I see. I'll honor the Herdmaster's gift.
say:14:1520906010:1.source_cn: 俺明白了，俺以后一定珍惜兽群之主赐予俺的恩赐！
say:14:1520906010:1.male: Now I see. I'll honor the Herdmaster's gift.
say:14:1520906010:1.female: Now I see. I'll honor the Herdmaster's gift.

say:16:1520906011:1.text:
Yes.
Since the Halians declared war, many have been wounded.
say:16:1520906011:1.source_cn: 有。\n自打呼临和我们开战，经常有人受重伤。

say:17:1520906012:1.male: Hunting God... do you mean to save them?
say:17:1520906012:1.female: Hunting Goddess... do you mean to save them?

say:19:1520906013:0.female: This is an honor beyond words!

say:24:1520906014:0.text: Forgive me... I never imagined the Hunting God would extend his grace to all!

say:24:1520906014:0.female: Forgive me... I never imagined the Hunting Goddess would extend her grace to all!
